mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing overcast skies and 50 degree temperatures near the Verona Public Library with a waning gibbous moon overhead. Please note that the ISS passes overhead tonight, but you will not be able to see it due to the clouds.
We have no new major city news articles or urgent emails to bring to your attention this morning.

There is plenty to do this weekend, starting with the Dane County Farmers Market today at the Capitol. You can also find live music at Baileys Run, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company all happening today.
In our weekly look at police activity, on October 25, officers arrested a man for an O W I offence after finding him in his vehicle at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue.
We are looking forward to a great day at Culver's, where today's featured flavor is Mint Explosion. The store opens today at 10:00 AM, so be sure to stop by for your favorite treat.
